Overview

MUJ HackX 4.0 is the flagship 36-hour international hackathon organized by the Department of Computer Science & Engineering, Manipal University Jaipur. Bringing together 4,000+ developers from 50+ institutions, the event challenges participants to transform bold ideas into impactful technology solutions while collaborating with like-minded innovators, industry mentors, and leading organizations.

The hackathon is designed to foster innovation by encouraging participants to solve real-world challenges using cutting-edge technologies. Beyond the competition, participants will gain hands-on experience, learn from industry experts, strengthen their technical skills, and build valuable professional connections.

HACKATHON HIGHLIGHTS

  • Participate in a 36-hour international hackathon.
  • Build innovative solutions for real-world challenges.
  • Collaborate with developers from 50+ institutions.
  • Learn from experienced mentors and industry experts.
  • Network with recruiters, innovators, and technology leaders.
  • Compete for exciting prizes and showcase your skills on a global stage.

WHY PARTICIPATE

MUJ HackX 4.0 is more than a hackathon. It is a platform to learn, innovate, and grow while solving meaningful challenges through technology.

Whether you're an aspiring developer, entrepreneur, or technology enthusiast, this is your opportunity to showcase your talent, build impactful solutions, and connect with the innovation ecosystem.

Eligibility

Profile Type:
Students
  • Open to undergraduate and postgraduate students from recognized institutions.
  • Teams must consist of 2 to 4 members.
  • Cross-college, cross-specialization, and cross-year teams are welcome.
  • A participant can be part of only one team.
  • Round 1 is completely online and free of cost.
  • A nominal participation fee will apply only to teams shortlisted for the offline round. Details will be shared with shortlisted teams.
  • International participants are welcome to participate in the online track.

Rules

1. Round 1 – Online Screening

  • Complete your registration and submit all required details before the deadline.
  • Teams will be shortlisted based on their technical profile, previous work, and registration responses.
  • Shortlisted teams will receive further instructions for the offline round.
  • A nominal participation fee will be applicable only for shortlisted teams. Details will be shared after shortlisting.

2. Round 2 – 36-Hour Hackathon (Offline)

  • Shortlisted teams must report to Manipal University Jaipur on the scheduled date and time.
  • Complete registration, verification, and check-in at the venue.
  • Problem statements will be revealed at the start of the hackathon.
  • Build, test, and refine your solution over 36 hours with guidance from mentors.
  • Submit the required deliverables before the deadline:
    • Working prototype
    • Presentation (PPT)
    • GitHub repository link (if applicable)

3. Final Evaluation

  • Finalist teams will present their solutions before the judging panel.
  • Teams will demonstrate their prototype, explain their approach, and showcase the impact of their solution.
  • Winners will be selected based on innovation, technical implementation, feasibility, presentation, and overall execution.

1. Team Formation

  • Teams must consist of 2 to 4 members.
  • A participant can be part of only one team.
  • Cross-college, cross-year, and cross-specialization teams are welcome.

2. Originality

  • All submissions must be original.
  • Plagiarism, cheating, or misrepresentation of work may result in immediate disqualification.

3. Submissions

  • Submit all required deliverables before the specified deadline.
  • Late or incomplete submissions may not be considered for evaluation.

4. Offline Participation

  • Participants must carry a valid student ID for verification.
  • Teams must attend all mandatory evaluations, mentoring sessions, and final presentations.

5. Code of Conduct

  • Maintain professional and respectful conduct throughout the event.
  • Harassment, misconduct, or disruptive behavior may result in disqualification.

6. Organizer Rights

  • Organizers reserve the right to modify the schedule, rules, or evaluation criteria if required.
  • Decisions made by the organizers and judging panel will be final and binding.
